evidence.excerpt: Puzović has an ongoing technical collaboration with PoliFlex d.o.o., a regional polyolefin film producer, through which production batch data are shared and confidential testing services are provided. She previously completed a six-month consulting engagement with a multinational food packaging converter during 2014–2015, advising on specification limits for multilayer barrier films used in chilled dairy products.
